protocol.answerOrder: Alternate the two arms in native question order. Complete all answers before grading.
protocol.grading: Use the unchanged blind authored correctness rubric. Regrade forty saved Qwen candidates with the same Sol judge.
protocol.calibration: Use fourteen authored positives and twenty fabricated negatives. Report six unavailable positive controls.
protocol.preparation: Reuse the saved graph and exact accepted Boros source contexts. Do not run compaction or native preparation.

optchatController.tools: Unchanged literal search, zoom, and source APIs.
optchatController.eviction: Remove complete duplicated groups. At capacity, remove older navigation groups before source groups.
optchatController.reduction: Reduce complete API pages. Do not cut original text or summaries.
optchatController.finalization: Use the existing final instruction without tools after capacity or step exhaustion.
optchatController.evidence: Compute delivered evidence from the final submitted request. Keep cumulative retrieval receipts separately.

backend.continuation: Replay visible messages and complete tool pairs. Recompute reasoning without provider reasoning items.

protocol.transport: Stateless Responses requests with visible conversation and paired tool results. Do not store hidden reasoning.
protocol.limitations: Reused development questions, Qwen-prepared summaries, saved Boros preparations, and the same Sol answerer and grader.
